method: Real Skater.update inputs with initial fixtures on actual collision surfaces; no direct grind attachment

checks.name: A–L rendered topography agrees with collisions and the playable footprint has no voids
A and C: trail entry, raised north deck and return remain connected
B: both mini transitions support repeated passes with an open flat bottom
B: either mini lip accepts a charged grind and exits onto the deck without a false bail
C: bowl-to-street connector rides smoothly in both directions
D: deep bowl and shallow tail have reachable physical approaches and exits
E and G downhill handrails accept a normal early-held grind in the direction of travel
E: holding grind during a late high ollie never reverses the rider uphill
D: ollie capture, continuous pool coping and ollie exit work both ways
F and H: an actual ollie captures each linked grind in both directions
H: quarter face, crest and back A-frame have continuous riding surfaces
I: both bank directions and its western landing edge remain usable
J and K: flat rail and manual-pad edges can be ollied onto and exited
L: both quarter heights roll in and return without false floor or wall hits
L: both quarter copings accept a charged approach and bank the grind on exit

coverage.A: Trail apron up/down, north entry to bowl deck
coverage.B: Repeated mini-ramp passes both ways, clear flat bottom and banked grind exits on both lips
coverage.C: Connected upper deck and street-bank ascent/descent
coverage.D: Deep bowl/shallow tail entry/exit; actual coping capture, continuous grind and ollie exit both ways
coverage.E: Seven-stair downhill handrail, early-held grind and late-ollie direction stability
coverage.F: Curved ledge capture, continuous linked grind and banked exit both ways
coverage.G: Nine-stair downhill handrail approach and banked exit
coverage.H: Continuous quarter/crest surface, back A-frame, both coping and kink-rail grinds in both directions
coverage.I: Bank up/down, west approach support and handrail grinds both ways
coverage.J: Flat rail capture and banked exits both ways
coverage.K: Manual-pad edge ollies and banked grinds both ways
coverage.L: Both quarter heights: approach, return and coping grinds
